items.title: Loading screen lacks gameplay context
items.what: The loading screen only shows the game's title and a progress bar, with no visual hint of the gameplay mechanics or setting
items.why: Players see only a logo and progress bar before gameplay starts, creating uncertainty about what they're about to play
items.how: Add a small animated preview of the twin-stick controls or a stylized dojo environment to the loading screen

items.title: Fighters occupy too little screen space
items.what: The two fighters are centered but sit in the lower third of the screen, leaving excessive empty space above them
items.why: The unused vertical space reduces visual impact and makes the action feel distant from the player
items.how: Shift the fighters upward by ~15% of screen height and scale them slightly larger to fill more of the vertical space

items.title: Control hints are hard to see
items.what: The 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' labels beneath the control sticks are small, low-contrast gray text against a dark background
items.why: Players may miss which stick controls which aspect during quick gameplay moments
items.how: Increase label size by 1.5x, use a brighter gold/orange color matching the HUD, and add a subtle glow effect

items.title: Move selection lacks visual feedback
items.what: When a move is selected (e.g., 'LUNGE PUNCH'), only the text label changes; the fighter animation doesn't preview the move
items.why: Players can't visually confirm they've selected the intended move before committing
items.how: Add a brief 0.3s preview animation of the selected move executing on the fighter when a technique is chosen

items.title: Rematch button is too small on portrait phones
items.what: The 'REMATCH' button in the results screen appears as a thin gold rectangle occupying only ~10% of screen width
items.why: On a 390px-wide portrait screen, the button is too small for comfortable thumb interaction
items.how: Increase the button width to span 70% of the screen and add a 4px rounded corner treatment for better tap targets
